notes: *both* is aligned to the plural construct בְּנֵי of the age formula, whose plurality distributes the age over the calf and the lamb, in one discontinuous unit *both ... old* headed on *old*; marking *both* `added` under rule 30 was the competing reading and is recorded in that unit's note as rule 8 requires.
שְׂעִיר עִזִּים is split *he* / *goat* rather than fused: the ASV spends a word on each morpheme, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet.
The לְ of לֵאמֹר is unrepresented under rule 27, and *Take ye* keeps its subject pronoun with the imperative under rule 17.
